title: PSG weighing up €70 million summer offer for versatile Barcelona defender – report
tweet: PSG have reportedly floated €70 m for 25‑year‑old Eric Garcia to cover Marquinhos and Hakimi. The defender has featured in eight of Barcelona’s ten matches and just signed a contract to 2031, so a sale is unlikely. As things stand, a deal depends on García’s willingness to leave and Barça’s willingness to negotiate.

title: Barcelona outcast now considering January exit after falling out of favour
tweet: Balde has spoken to Mendes about a January move after 12 minutes of play across 10 matches, a sign that Flick has moved on. If sold, the exit would give Barça a chance to add a left‑footed centre‑back while filling the gap left by Christensen’s injury.

title: Barcelona continue to shatter records with another in sight heading into Real Betis clash
tweet: Barcelona's 84 Champions League goals in 28 games under Flick average three per game, the highest ever since the current format. If they beat Betis they’ll equal Madrid's nine‑match start record. As things stand, the momentum is unmistakable.

title: Barcelona missed out on Senegalese wonderkid after family opted for AC Milan
tweet: Barcelona nearly signed 18‑year‑old Malick Cisse, but his family chose AC Milan’s development project instead. The move underscores Barça’s ongoing interest in African talent, even as they now keep a close eye on other prospects such as JJ Gabriel.

title: Barcelona’s plan to prepare teenage summer signing for first-team football under Flick
tweet: Barcelona paid €8.5 million for 18‑year‑old Jesse Bisiwu and keeps the same development plan: first‑team training, match rhythm with Barça Atlètic, learning Flick’s style under Belletti. As things stand, the reserve side is the key step to senior football, but the window for a breakthrough remains tight.

title: Barcelona not ruling out January sale of midfielder returning from injury – report
tweet: De Jong’s return faces a crowded pivot – Rodri and Pedri are already entrenched, with Gavi, Bernal and Farinas adding depth. Barcelona could consider a January sale if he cannot re‑establish himself in the starting line‑up, but an exit remains uncertain.

title: Former Spain striker ‘dreams’ of seeing Barcelona captain at Juventus: “He’s a complete forward”
tweet: Fernando Llorente said he would dream of seeing Raphinha at Juventus, calling him a complete forward. The comment underscores Raphinha's growing reputation beyond Barcelona. Whether it signals genuine interest remains to be seen.
